title: Water through piezoelectric spirals generating electricity

tellings.quote: Maybe the water goes through the these spirals, and the spirals are uh made by piezoelectric material.

plain: The researcher Filippo Biondi, who scanned beneath the Khafre pyramid at Giza, wonders whether water once ran through spiral structures under it that were "made by piezoelectric material," a material that produces electricity when it is squeezed or shaken. He offers it as a "maybe" and draws on the ideas of Christopher Dunn. If so, the pyramid would have been a machine for making power rather than only a tomb.
